correctness.rationale: The exact joint upper-orthant count p(n-H)/p(n), H=∑_{k≥1} k max_{i:k≤L_i} r_i, is a bijective mandatory-copy removal. With fixed ranks L_i=⌊x_i n^{1/4}⌋, H=O(√n); the uniform Hardy–Ramanujan p(n-H)/p(n) ratio and a Riemann sum yield the nested independent-Rayleigh-record law. Exact marked coefficient p(n-A)-p(n-A-m), A=s m(m-1)/2+jm, followed by a uniform local ratio and tightness, establishes J_s asymptotically uniform and independent of location. Event M_r=M_s iff J_s<r proves r/s without incorrectly passing equality probabilities through weak convergence. Independent reconstruction checked 1,292 exact arithmetic comparisons for all partitions through n=18, not used as proof of infinite asymptotics.

value.rationale: The first-deficient-part hierarchy of ordinary partitions is a canonical object and its dependency across ranks cannot be recovered from known one-dimensional Rayleigh marginals. The exact nested minima and uniform marks answer natural simultaneous-rank and tie-probability questions, including an explicit structural collision law r/s; this is not an arbitrary parameter slice or routine restatement of one marginal.
